decision.name: Target-ambiguity witness and one additional discriminating rheology point
decision.plain_language: Keep the frozen generator. Ask whether two declared rheological curves can both match the same six low-rate anchors but disagree enough in the high-rate targets to matter. If so, expose that ambiguity and test whether one carefully selected extra point resolves it.
decision.minimal_material_increment: A query-level, target-specific insufficiency diagnostic for precursor-ink continuation, linked to an information-matched7-point discrimination experiment. The incremental contribution must be new material evidence of this diagnostic beyond GP uncertainty, anchor-distance OOD scores and simple probe policies; it is not a new theorem, new general Gaussian family or invented calibration guarantee.
decision.why_before_A_or_B: Before learning more directions or a richer code distribution, establish whether the low-rate observations contain enough information about the high-rate branch. When compatible branches cannot be distinguished, additional model flexibility cannot guarantee the correct branch.
decision.current_paper_relation: Separate future branch. The present bounded retrospective MLST paper and frozen evidence stay intact. This route is not a mandatory new publication prerequisite and no proposed outcome is inserted into current Results.

route_comparison.proposal: Select physical shape directions using conditional target impact and anchor observability.
route_comparison.value: Could replace arbitrary windows by a task-grounded representation while retaining full residual.
route_comparison.main_problem: A naive high-observability direction can have zero effect after conditioning; learned directions also add representation capacity beyond five correction parameters. Query-mask-specific rotations may lose the single shared joint law.
route_comparison.decision: Not first. First separate conditional influence from mere observability and establish a new material need. Do not market generalized eigenvectors, active subspaces or GP design as new algorithms.

route_comparison.proposal: Coherent non-Gaussian curve-specific scale or shape with complete residual.
route_comparison.value: Can represent value-dependent scale and potentially multiple conditional branches.
route_comparison.main_problem: Student-t scale mixtures are directly mature and already diagnosed here. Two-component shape mixtures are classical Gaussian-mixture families and their regime parameters may be poorly identified with25complete curves. A richer prior cannot resolve observationally identical branches.
route_comparison.decision: Not first. Reopen only with measured evidence of separated conditional regimes and a capacity-matched Gaussian-mixture/Student-t comparison, not a new name for a scale mixture.

route_comparison.proposal: Identify target-relevant ambiguity in six-anchor continuation and test one discriminating probe.
route_comparison.value: Directly addresses confident but wrong continuation even when anchors look in-domain; leaves strong frozen generator intact.
route_comparison.main_problem: Constitutive class and tolerances must be justified; broad classes can make almost every curve ambiguous, narrow boxes can make false safety. Absence of a witness is not evidence of reliability.
route_comparison.decision: Recommended single bounded next line; first analytical/synthetic falsification, then genuine unconsumed same-domain evidence if available.

A_influence_identity.definitions: For reference joint Gaussian and unit-prior code z, C_R=Cov(Y_R,z), U_H=C_H-K_HO K_OO^{-1} C_O.
A_influence_identity.equation: At S=I, d E_theta[Y_H|y_O]/d a = U_H. For an infinitesimal code covariance perturbation E, d Cov_theta[Y_H|y_O] = U_H E U_H^T.
A_influence_identity.consequence: If z is exactly determined by noiseless anchors O, Var(z|O)=0 implies U_H=Cov(Y_H,z|O)=0. Maximizing anchor-observability alone can choose a direction whose prior replacement has no effect on missing targets.
A_influence_identity.novelty_status: Elementary Gaussian-conditioning derivation, not a proposed new theorem and not a numerical finding on our materials.

B_coherent_neighbor.equation: p(Y_R)=sum_k pi_k N(m0_R+C_R a_k, R_R+C_R S_k C_R^T), R_R=K0_R-C_R C_R^T.
B_coherent_neighbor.meaning: A shared global component gives a coherent mixture with a retained full residual; posterior weights can depend on observed anchors.
B_coherent_neighbor.limitation: This is an existing mixture-family construction. Coordinate-wise gates do not automatically give the same coherent full-curve law. Neither version creates information about branches indistinguishable at O.

C_compatibility_set.coordinates: f(t)=log viscosity with dimensionless log shear rate t; positive fixed target weights sum to1.
C_compatibility_set.equation: F_delta(O)={f in declared F_const: max_{j in O}|f(t_j)-y_j| <= delta_j}.
C_compatibility_set.required_inputs: Declared Cross/Carreau compatibility union or another justified precursor-ink class; physical/protocol state and admissible parameter boxes; anchor measurement tolerances delta_j and target accuracy tolerance tau. None is inferred from current failure scores.
C_compatibility_set.witness: A found feasible pair (f_plus,f_minus) with distance>2*tau proves that no point curve can be within tau of both. Proof: triangle inequality. This is conditional on the declared class/tolerances; it is not a failure probability or empirical coverage guarantee.
C_compatibility_set.numerical_direction: A feasible pair gives a lower bound on A; incomplete search cannot certify small A. No witness found must remain UNKNOWN, not SAFE.
C_compatibility_set.scope: Targets are only the higher-rate continuation region selected before outcome access, inside the declared coordinate support.

C_analytical_positive_control.family: eta_c(gamma)=eta0/[1+(gamma/c)^m], m>0, a Cross-type zero-high-plateau subfamily used only as a mathematical counterexample.
C_analytical_positive_control.anchors: For gamma_j<=a and c>=a/(exp(delta)-1)^(1/m), log(eta0)-log(eta_c(gamma_j))<=delta. Thus different transition scales can all fit nearly flat low-rate anchors within delta>0.
C_analytical_positive_control.targets: Two finite scales c1,c2 satisfying that bound differ at target b by |log(1+(b/c1)^m)-log(1+(b/c2)^m)|. If this exceeds2tau, they supply an explicit ambiguity witness.
C_analytical_positive_control.limits: This shows existence under a specified family and positive tolerance; it does not establish ambiguity of the actual25/46curves, physical validity for every hydrogel, or a new non-identifiability theorem.

C_probe.purpose: Select one allowed extra measurement that separates the witness pair relative to measurement precision.
C_probe.known_mechanism: Maximum disagreement is a standard experimental-design principle; novelty must be the target-specific precursor-ink evidence and controlled workflow, not this argmax alone.
C_probe.no_guarantee: The largest pair-separation point need not minimize global ambiguity; evaluate remaining feasible branches after the probe. If it fails, retain that failure rather than add gating patches.

minimal_falsification_protocol.phase0: No material fitting: verify the elementary influence identity and explicit Cross-type witness algebra with data-free cases. Reject the naive most-observable-is-best criterion. No synthetic output counted as a measurement.
minimal_falsification_protocol.phase1: Before new target access fix F_const, parameter boxes, source of delta/sigma, tau, one6-anchor rule, separate Gamma_probe and H_eval, witness-search budget, all comparators and all failure outcomes. If tolerances/state cannot be justified, stop at a proposal rather than claim a useful safety detector.
minimal_falsification_protocol.phase2: Use previously consumed25/46only for explicitly labeled exploratory debugging if necessary; never rebrand resplits or re-scoring as independent confirmation. For confirmation use genuinely unconsumed compatible precursor-ink formulations/preparations with retained identities and measurement-state metadata.
minimal_falsification_protocol.fixed_score_targets: Define H_eval disjoint from Gamma_probe before masking. Every probe policy selects one point from the same allowed pool and is scored on the same H_eval. Do not let each policy remove its chosen hard target from its own scoring set.
minimal_falsification_protocol.fair_acquisition_comparison: For a clean acquisition-only comparison, all policies use the same fixed GP predictor conditioned on six anchors plus one selected probe. This isolates measurement choice from generator choice. The frozen public six-anchor interface is not silently extended: any7-anchor adapter is a separately versioned future implementation, not a replay of the present model.
strong_baselines: Random one-probe policy with prespecified seeds
GP target-integrated variance reduction or target mutual information
Anchor Mahalanobis/OOD-distance and GP predictive-width rankings for selective-risk comparisons
reporting: Primary fixed-H_eval log-scale CRPS at equal7-point information budget, with paired material-unit differences against strongest acquisition control.
Point error,90percent marginal coverage, interval score and full failure counts retained as secondary endpoints.
For6-anchor insufficiency ranking report the full risk-retention curve and any author-prespecified retention/accuracy requirement; no best threshold picked from test outcomes.
Report all cases: witness found; no witness within budget/UNKNOWN; empty compatibility set/specification failure; no discriminating probe; successful or unsuccessful post-probe resolution.
No measured instrument-time or material-saving claim from retrospective masks. A physical sparse protocol can change shear history and requires its own experiment.
critical_counterexamples: Known synthetic pair with indistinguishable anchors and different high-rate transition must be detected within tolerance.
A uniquely determined or target-identical pair must not be declared ambiguous simply because parameter values differ.
Cases with anchors in the reference support/distribution but divergent high-rate branches test whether this adds anything beyond ordinary OOD distance.
Very broad and narrowed parameter boxes must be reported; apparent safety that disappears under a scientifically reasonable box change falsifies robustness.
minimal_falsification_protocol.success_thresholds: No invented N, tau, retention or significance target. Authors must choose useful accuracy/retention requirements before target reveal. Minimum scientific go/no-go is a useful nontrivial retention and a reproducible improvement over the strongest equally informed probe/uncertainty baseline, with honest uncertainty across material units.
stop_conditions: Stop if the class/tolerances require test-target tuning or cannot be justified from measurement/protocol information.
Stop if almost all curves are rejected or UNKNOWN and no useful prespecified retention is attainable.
Stop the incremental-method claim if ambiguity rank is only a proxy for shear-rate span, anchor Mahalanobis distance or GP width and adds no independent material benefit.
Stop if one highest-rate point or GP target-variance reduction matches or beats the witness probe; publish the negative scientific boundary if useful, do not attach more gates.
Stop if the feasible class is empty for important eligible inks, showing a constitutive-specification problem. Do not silently drop those materials.
Do not pursue a larger mixture/diffusion model to evade a positive insufficiency witness. Additional observations or weaker claims are the appropriate boundary.

novelty_boundary: The eight selected works show mature ingredients. The recommended material-level question and its proposed combined evidence workflow may be useful, but this bounded search neither proves absence of an identical hydrogel study nor predicts journal acceptance. Recheck exact near-neighbors if a concrete implementation and new evidence justify pursuing this branch.
